name: mod-roulette
about: Roulette (mods/roulette: HWP/Roulette) through the fix_roulette bot, in town as the host, solo: the wheel sits on a table in the tavern's main hall, that table bare (its default scene); `hwp roulette` reports a betting round and 157 bets; using the wheel opens HWPRouletteMenu; with Luck 20, 1000 each on s:17, c:13, odd and red and a forced 17, the wheel shows its spin scene and the round pays the stakes back plus 35, 8 and 1 times 1000 raised by the bonus (red loses); chips cleared in the next round come back; the 1,000,000 limit refuses an eleventh 100K chip; after tavern upgrades to tiers 2 and 3 the one wheel is back on a main-hall table. Shots: roulette-wheel, roulette-menu, roulette-spin, roulette-result, roulette-tier2, roulette-tier3.
